name: io.github.PhilipAD/health-export-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Folder holding .health-cache.json from the MetricBridge iOS app. Unset on a Mac, the server reads ~/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~ai~healthexport~app/Documents if it exists.

environmentVariables.name: PAIRING_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Only if Agent pairing is on in the iOS app (Settings > Agent pairing).

environmentVariables.name: HEALTH_EXPORT_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Only if Export encryption is on in the iOS app.
